transform: Within each saved seed/fold, rank all evaluation scores to percentiles, then average seed percentiles per call. Descriptive, uses evaluation distribution; not an online score.
alignment: Scored calls before first positive call; unscored calls may intervene.
gate: Median paired leak-minus-previous-scored-call percentile increase has family-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 in every model/cohort.
examples: One fresh leaking episode per model, upper median of scored sequence length, episode path tie-break; requires at least five scored calls.
